sampling_component: 25 free corpus-blind adversarial cases; no assigned area

cases.location: wooden bridge over a drainage ditch near a Novgorod trading street
cases.person: a salt seller leading a loaded sledge
cases.circumstances: thaw has softened planks and one runner has broken through a gap
cases.situation: The seller asks passers-by to help unload sacks before the sledge tips, while buyers worry that wet salt will be lost.

cases.location: riverbank below a village landing on Lake Ilmen
cases.circumstances: night frost has fixed the boats to shore ice, but midday sun has opened a black channel beside them
cases.situation: He sees an oar drifting beyond the new channel and considers reaching it with a pole before its owner returns.

cases.location: smoke-darkened room of a town tanner
cases.circumstances: a dog has dragged a half-cured hide from its frame into a puddle of lime water
cases.situation: The apprentice must decide whether to rinse and re-stretch the hide or hide damage until master notices it.

cases.location: forest track between two clearings south of Novgorod
cases.person: a widow carrying a bundle of flax
cases.circumstances: fresh wheel ruts show that a cart passed after last rain, though road ahead is blocked by a fallen pine
cases.situation: She hears axe blows beyond tree and cannot tell whether men are clearing road or waiting behind it.

cases.location: churchyard edge in a small settlement
cases.circumstances: a spring storm has torn loose a roof shingle and rain now falls onto stored firewood
cases.situation: He asks nearby children for help, but their mothers have warned them not to climb anything near church.

cases.location: crowded market row beside fur stalls
cases.circumstances: his interpreter has gone to fetch food and a local buyer insists a bundle of squirrel pelts was counted short
cases.situation: Neither man shares enough language to settle whether two pelts are missing or stuck together in damp packing.

cases.location: shallow ford on a tributary of the Volkhov
cases.circumstances: his horse has lost a shoe and water is rising from rain upstream
cases.situation: He must choose between attempting ford immediately, finding a smith in nearby hamlet, or seeking longer route to a bridge.

cases.location: communal bakehouse behind several town households
cases.circumstances: a coal has rolled beneath a bench where a sleeping cat has left straw bedding
cases.situation: Smoke is beginning to rise, and she has dough-covered hands while oven door stands open.

cases.location: wet meadow beside a hay stack
cases.circumstances: they find a wax-sealed birch-bark strip tangled in last year's grass
cases.situation: One wants to take it to a literate neighbor; other fears touching a stranger's message may bring accusation.

cases.location: courtyard of a potter near the city rampart
cases.circumstances: the firing kiln has developed a crack and rain clouds gather before glazed cups are dry
cases.situation: She weighs patching kiln with wet clay, moving cups indoors, or risking one hurried firing.

cases.location: birch grove near a charcoal burner's hut
cases.circumstances: his covered wood pile gives off white smoke from an unexpected side vent
cases.situation: He suspects rain has opened mound, but cannot leave it unattended while a child searches for a lost mitten nearby.

cases.location: landing stage on the Volkhov at dusk
cases.person: a boatwoman returning with empty baskets
cases.circumstances: a foreign merchant has left a locked chest on her boat and gone ashore without explanation
cases.situation: River current is strengthening and her family expects boat home before dark.

cases.location: field margin outside a village
cases.circumstances: his ox has stopped and keeps turning its head toward a hoof caught in a twisted leather trace
cases.situation: The ploughman is alone, daylight is short, and a second ox is still harnessed to the heavy plough.

cases.location: narrow lane beside a wealthy household's fence
cases.circumstances: she hears a baby crying behind fence and sees smoke escaping through a gap under gate
cases.situation: No adult is visible in lane, and her wooden yoke makes climbing fence difficult.

cases.location: winter camp beside a frozen marsh road
cases.person: a traveler with a lame foot
cases.circumstances: his companions have gone ahead for dry fuel, leaving a small fire and two tied packhorses
cases.situation: A stranger approaches from tree line asking to warm hands and borrow an axe.

cases.location: cellar beneath a Novgorod household
cases.circumstances: a clay jar of fermented cabbage has cracked and brine is running toward sacks of grain
cases.situation: The mistress is away, keys to storeroom are on nail upstairs, and a rat has begun chewing at wet sack.

cases.location: roadside shrine beside a crossroads
cases.circumstances: he finds a wagon wheel pin lying in mud near fresh tracks that turn toward swamp
cases.situation: He may pursue wagon to return pin, leave it where found, or keep it as useful iron.

cases.location: small boat among reed beds on Lake Ilmen
cases.circumstances: his net has snagged on something heavy below water and a thunderstorm is moving over open lake
cases.situation: Pulling harder may free net or capsize boat; cutting it loses week's most valuable gear.

cases.location: smithy doorway in a riverside hamlet
cases.circumstances: her father has collapsed from heat while a customer waits beside glowing iron
cases.situation: She knows bellows and water bucket but has never been allowed to strike work meant for another household.

cases.location: upper room of a merchant's lodging
cases.circumstances: ink has spilled across a debt list moments before two disputing traders arrive
cases.situation: Some names remain legible, but totals and one witness mark are blurred beyond certainty.

cases.location: willow-lined bank outside a fishing village
cases.circumstances: she discovers a trapped beaver alive but badly tangled in an old cord
cases.situation: Its pelt would be valuable, yet freeing it risks bite and may anger whoever set trap.

cases.location: storehouse lane near Novgorod market
cases.circumstances: he smells fresh smoke from a shuttered storehouse but hears no flame crackle and sees no owner
cases.situation: Breaking seal may save goods or falsely accuse an absent trader of negligence.

cases.location: peaty shore of a woodland lake
cases.circumstances: a child has followed her and slipped one leg into soft bog while reaching for bright berries
cases.situation: The healer has a staff and gathering basket but no rope, and child panics when told not to move.

cases.location: covered passage between town yards
cases.circumstances: he notices barrel hoop is loosening as client argues with someone inside house
cases.situation: Barrel contains lamp oil, and setting it down roughly could spill contents across dry boards.

cases.location: edge of a rye field near a monastery road
cases.person: a novice sent to collect mushrooms
cases.circumstances: he finds a wounded hawk caught in a simple snare beside a sack marked with another household's sign
cases.situation: He must decide whether to tend bird, seek owner of sack, or hurry back before evening gate is barred.
